captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a ceiling-suspended cassette air conditioning unit, consisting of a large main square body and a flat, thin perimeter panel. The central intake area features a square grille, surrounded by four adjustable outlet flaps designed to pivot on horizontal hinges at each edge. On one side of the lower panel, two small, square service buttons are located, which function as independent prismatic push controls. The entire assembly is finished in a uniform matte light gray, simulating commercial-grade plastic and metal casing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a ceiling-suspended cassette air conditioning machine with a square panel and a central intake grille. The model must include four perimeter outlet flaps that rotate on horizontal revolute joints, and two small service buttons on the lower panel that operate as prismatic push controls, using a clean matte gray material.
captions.factory: The code constructs the cassette unit by first defining a base 'panel' using a thin box and subtracting a central square opening to form the intake frame. The main body is created as a larger box centered on top of the panel. Four outlet flaps are modeled as thin rectangular strips and attached to each side of the frame via revolute joints. Finally, two small square buttons are created on one side of the panel, with prismatic joints to allow vertical compression.
